_note: Schema for HXQ asset receipts. Every HXQ-compressed shard or cartridge tensor must have a receipt matching this schema before promotion to active.

cosine_min.description: Minimum cosine similarity across all tensor groups (must be >= 0.998 for promotion)

max_abs_diff.description: Maximum absolute difference between original and reconstructed values

ppl_baseline.description: Perplexity of baseline (Q5_K_M or Q8_0) model

ppl_delta_pct.description: PPL change as percentage: (compressed - baseline) / baseline * 100

behavioral_eval_pass.description: Whether behavioral evaluation passed (same prompts, same tasks, same scoring)

behavioral_eval_receipt.description: Path to behavioral evaluation receipt JSON

_promotion_rules.quarantine: Set when HXQ eval fails or tensor fidelity drops below threshold
_promotion_rules.fallback: If HXQ load/eval fails, runtime falls back to fallback_shard (standard GGUF)

_codec_recommendations.gpu_edge: hxq_affine_6 — tighter memory, fits more in VRAM
_codec_recommendations.pod: q8_0 — highest fidelity for cloud compute
